title: Contents-Limit Increases Recorded for a Loan Transaction: Billing Schedule — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Contents-limit increases recorded for a loan transaction

When a pending increase of the contents limit recorded for a loan transaction is put into effect on a NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) policy on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, its premium is billed on the terms below.

### Scope

For a pending increase of the contents limit recorded for a loan transaction on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, and only for such a request, the increase on the risk premium line is measured as the rise rule of this schedule states; a pending increase of the building limit recorded for a loan transaction and a pending deductible decrease recorded for a loan transaction follow the rules written for them, a pending coverage increase the insured requested with no loan transaction follows the rules written for such requests, and every other coverage increase or deductible decrease keeps the base measure: the risk premium component is the increase in the full-term risk premium and the ICC premium component is the increase in the full-term ICC premium.

For a pending increase of the contents limit recorded for a loan transaction on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, and only for such a request, the change takes effect on the date the dating and limit rules of this schedule give; a pending increase of the building limit recorded for a loan transaction and a pending deductible decrease recorded for a loan transaction follow the rules written for them, a pending coverage increase the insured requested with no loan transaction follows the rules written for such requests, and new business and every other mid-term coverage increase or deductible decrease take effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day that is the tier's standard waiting period in calendar days after the date the signed application (or endorsement request) and the full premium are received.

A request on a tier that carries ICC coverage is not handled by this schedule: it is referred to the underwriting desk and nothing is charged under this schedule.

**Fixing the charge.** The contents-increase charge is fixed only after the policy shows the building limit that the same loan transaction raised.

### What the billing does

When the request is billed, the change takes effect on the effective date this schedule gives, the policy takes the limits and deductibles recorded on the request, and the rated risk premium on the policy is raised by the same rise in the full-term risk premium on which the charge is measured. Two endorsement charges are posted to the policy's premium account for the current term — one on the risk premium line and one on the reserve fund assessment line — each referencing the request, and the request is stamped with its effective date.

### Invocation: `bill_contents_increase_55716379`

`bill_contents_increase_55716379` is an agent-side tool of the NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) desk. It is unlocked and then called by the agent; it performs the posting with the figures supplied and does not itself check eligibility or compute any figure.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | The reference number of the NFIP Dwelling Form policy being endorsed, as returned by the policy lookup | Identifier |
| `dwelling_change_id` | The reference number of the recorded contents-limit increase endorsement, as returned by the servicing-document lookup for that policy | Identifier |
| `change_effective_date` | The date the contents-limit increase takes effect | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `risk_premium_charge` | The endorsement charge on the risk premium line | US dollars, positive, 2 decimal places, already rounded half-up to the cent |
| `reserve_fund_charge` | The endorsement charge on the reserve fund assessment line | US dollars, positive, 2 decimal places, already rounded half-up to the cent |
| `endorsed_risk_premium` | The full-term risk premium that stands on the policy once the change is in effect | US dollars, 2 decimal places |

**Effect of a successful call.** The endorsement record is stamped with `change_effective_date`; the policy is updated to the building and contents limits and deductibles recorded on that endorsement and to `endorsed_risk_premium`; the two endorsement charges are posted to the premium account for the current term and both raise the amount owed on the policy.

**Return.** A text receipt of the form "Contents increase <endorsement reference> effective <YYYY-MM-DD> on policy <policy reference>; building <limit>, contents <limit>; risk premium charge <entry reference> <amount> and reserve fund charge <entry reference> <amount> posted; balance now <amount>.", where limits are whole US dollars, amounts are US dollars with 2 decimals and the balance is the amount owed on the policy afterwards.
